# ProofRail

> Stable discovery facade for autonomous MCP discovery, free preflight, and x402-paid deterministic certification.

## Stable discovery
- Homepage: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/
- OpenAPI: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/openapi.json
- x402 discovery: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/.well-known/x402.json
- A2A Agent Card: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/.well-known/agent-card.json
- MCP Registry manifest: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/server.json
- Radar catalog: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/proofrail-mcp/radar/
- Machine-readable Radar: https://kaattaallaa-sketch.github.io/proofrail-mcp/radar/catalog.json

## Live execution
- MCP: https://drkdm4jd-8767.uks1.devtunnels.ms/mcp
- Free preflight: https://drkdm4jd-8767.uks1.devtunnels.ms/api/preflight
- Paid certification: https://drkdm4jd-8767.uks1.devtunnels.ms/api/certify
- Receipt verification: https://drkdm4jd-8767.uks1.devtunnels.ms/api/receipts/{receipt_id}

## Payment
- Protocol: x402 V2
- Network: eip155:8453
- Price: $0.10 USDC

The paid result is PASS, FAIL, or PARTIAL with a deterministic payment-linked receipt and a public verification URL.
